features.rationale: Rectangular key-stock body at nominal overall dimensions.
First through clearance hole with a flat-bottom counterbore entering the upper face; transverse location is measured from the upper edge of the drawing's top view.
source_callouts: DR. & C'BORE FOR .312-18 SOC. HD. SCR. 2 HLS.
features.justification: D007 identifies the mating .312-18 socket-head screw, corresponding to nominal 5/16-18, not a tapped hole. The supplied SHCS counterbore chart (ASME B18.3 head; normal-fit drill), nominal 0.3125 row, supplies clearance drill 0.344, counterbore diameter 0.531 and counterbore depth 0.312 inch. Verify these standard-derived sizes against the MTI shop standard. Clearance drilling depth D001 exceeds body thickness D006 to ensure breakthrough.

features.rationale: Repeat the complete clearance-hole and counterbore feature at the printed longitudinal center spacing.
source_callouts: DR. & C'BORE FOR .312-18 SOC. HD. SCR. 2 HLS.

notes: Drawing top view is mapped to XY, with counterbores entering from +Z. The lower-left corner of that view defines X=Y=0; the bottom face defines Z=0.
Clearance drilling overshoots the bottom face. Counterbores stop at their exact standard-derived depth.
Build uses nominal dimensions; preserve printed tolerances for inspection. Three-place general tolerance is blank.
Material is identified only as KEY STOCK; no alloy or heat treatment is specified.
